Of the ramen the writer actually tasted, the 鶏豚骨ラーメン: 「スープを飲んでみたところ「豚骨・鶏ガラ」のスープ…クリーミーな口あたりでチキンコンソメの香りが強めに感じます。味付けはほんのり塩味がある程度でした。」 The shoyu that IS documented belongs to a mazesoba, not a ramen: the menu lists 魚介醤油まぜそば, and a Tabelog review adds 「相方は「魚介醤油まぜそば」をオーダー。こちらは醤油ダシに、チャーシュー、燻製卵、ネギ、海苔、ゴマ、ニンニク、背脂（？）がトッピング。」
http: 200 plain curl on the cited article; 200 iPhone UA on the Tabelog review
method: 1 plain fetch of the cited page, then 2 (iPhone UA) on Tabelog for the dish that actually carries the soy sauce
note: The exact pattern to watch for, and it lands on the wrong bowl. The record extends a soy-sauce warning to 'shoyu-seasoned ramen' at a shop whose own cited page says the ramen it tasted was seasoned ほんのり塩味 - lightly SALTY. A coeliac is not helped by being told the salt bowl is a soy bowl, and the shop's other ramen (鶏煎干・魚介鶏豚骨) have no tare described anywhere I could reach. Narrow the claim to the dish that earns it - 魚介醤油まぜそば, whose 醤油ダシ is documented at the Tabelog URL above - and drop 'curry sauces' until the roux question is settled. The wheat that covers every bowl here is the 麺屋棣鄂 noodles, which the record already has.

quote: Broths are chicken/pork-bone based and mazesoba/keema use ground meat, house-made bacon, egg yolk, cheese and pork back fat; no plant-based preparation exists.
found: The cited page carries only the broth half: 「スープを飲んでみたところ「豚骨・鶏ガラ」のスープ…これは鶏豚骨をミキサーしたスープです。」 plus 「チャーシューは肩ロース」. The bacon, cheese, egg and back fat are real but live at a DIFFERENT url - Tabelog review by 京きのこ (visit 2022/08): 「「キーマカレーまぜそば」は、カレールゥと炙られた自家製ベーコンとチーズ、生卵がトッピングされて、これを、まぜまぜいただきます。」 and 「魚介醤油まぜそば…チャーシュー、燻製卵、ネギ、海苔、ゴマ、ニンニク、背脂（？）がトッピング。」
method: 1 plain fetch of the cited page, then Ecosia to surface the review, then 2 (iPhone UA) to read it
note: Good news for once: the oddly specific detail is NOT invented - house-made bacon, cheese and raw egg on the keema mazesoba, and chashu, smoked egg and 背脂 on the 魚介醤油まぜそば, are all documented, just not on the page we cite. Repoint the citation to the Tabelog review and the record becomes properly sourced. Two caveats to carry across: (a) the reviewer wrote 背脂（？） with a question mark, so record the back fat as reported-uncertain rather than as fact; (b) the review is from 2022/08, when the shop still traded as CURRY SHOP LEE, though both dishes survive on the 2024 ramen menu. 'Ground meat' is our own word - the page says キーマカレー and 台湾まぜそば, which conventionally use minced pork but are not spelled out. The conclusion, vegan 'no', is right either way: every broth is 豚骨・鶏ガラ and the only plant items on the page are toppings (岩海苔・ほうれん草・白ねぎ・メンマ) sitting in an animal soup.

why: Tabelog detail 200 via iPhone UA on 2026-08-21 with the 公式 badge - hours published by the operator.
